description: One per assistant message. Self-contained: it repeats the envelope fields so it can be used on its own. Unknown fields are allowed (v1 ignore-unknown rule).

message.description: OpenAI-style chat message. content is omitted when the message only calls tools; tool_calls is omitted when there are none; null fields are omitted, not sent as null.

arguments.description: A JSON-encoded string, not an object.

parent_tool_use_id.description: Id of the Task tool call when the message comes from a sub-agent, else null.
